content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Research on soil buffering capacity and lime requirement estimation has been conducted specifically for Vojvodina chernozem and hydromorphic soil associations using SMP buffer methodology and acid-base titration.","sources":[{"id":"R0013","field":"keywords","quote":"soil buffering capacity lime requirement Vojvodina soils"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-00143","field":"abstract","quote":"SMP buffer showed the strongest linear relationship with incubation lime requirement"}]},{"text":"Buffer pH methods have been compared and calibrated locally with regression equations developed for different soil texture classes to predict lime requirements across Vojvodina municipalities.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-00143","field":"abstract","quote":"Regression equations specific to chernozem texture classes are presented"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-00143","field":"abstract","quote":"regional recalibration is necessary before any single buffer method is adopted"}]},{"text":"Long-term field experiments have quantified how repeated limestone applications alter soil buffer curves and acid-base titration characteristics, with buffer capacity calculated as proportional to cumulative CaCO₃ input.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-00147","field":"abstract","quote":"Buffer capacity calculated as the slope of the linear portion of the titration curve increased proportionally"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-00147","field":"abstract","quote":"12-year field experiment on a slightly acid chernozem"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher has directly addressed lime requirement prediction accounting for soil texture and buffering capacity in Vojvodina soils through SMP buffer calibration, texture-specific regression equations, and long-term field validation data [SYN-PUB-00143, SYN-PUB-00147], precisely matching the challenge's need for a soil-type-adjusted liming recommendation model."}
